video.title: The REAL Reason I Quit YouTube (And Why I’m Back)

summary: Spencer Haws of Niche Pursuits explains why he stopped posting on YouTube for a year and why he is returning. His channel served as a funnel (brand, email list, podcast) to sell his software, Long Tail Pro and later Link Whisper, which he sold for $2.7M in January 2025 after six years. He no longer needs the money, bought an e-commerce business with his brother, and discloses a benign pituitary tumour that explained his low motivation. Key takeaway: content channels are distribution for a product; evergreen videos compound.

steps: Publish educational YouTube videos for brand awareness
Push viewers to email list and podcast
Sell your own software to the warmed audience
Field inbound acquisition interest once the product is large

warnings.warning: Persistent low motivation may have a medical cause; he had a benign pituitary tumour lowering testosterone, found via blood tests and MRI.

quote.text: I have a 21 millimeter mass, which is the size of a grape growing on my pituitary gland
quote.speaker: Spencer Haws

warnings.warning: Running multiple businesses at once for years meant juggling a lot; he chose to pause after the exit.

quote.text: I've been running multiple businesses at the same time. I've been juggling a lot of balls
quote.speaker: Spencer Haws

lessons.lesson: A YouTube channel's primary purpose is usually brand awareness for a product, not ad revenue.

quote.text: Like most YouTube channels, my primary purpose is not to make money through YouTube ads
quote.speaker: Spencer Haws

lessons.lesson: An evergreen video library keeps compounding views and subscribers even after you stop posting.
A content audience generates inbound acquirers for the product; multiple buyers approached him.

quote.text: I started getting more and more businesses reaching out to me asking to acquire Link Whisper
quote.speaker: Spencer Haws

lessons.lesson: Without a product to sell, a content channel loses its business purpose; tie content to an offer.

quote.text: I'm staring at a YouTube channel that I no longer have a product for
quote.speaker: Spencer Haws

lessons.lesson: Retired founders often come back within a year; he lasted about 10 months.

quote.text: I only lasted about 10 months before I came out of retirement
quote.speaker: Spencer Haws

lessons.lesson: Enjoying the creative process sustains content creation beyond money.
